JPL-ROB.title: JPL Robotics - Mars Pathfinder rover (Sojourner)
JPL-ROB.used: 65 x 48 x 30 cm, 10.5 kg, 6 driven wheels / 4 corner steering, 11 brushed motors (6+4+1), aerogel-insulated chassis, APXS on an extendable mechanism, UHF to lander

JPL-SE.title: JPL Robotics - Pathfinder software & electronics
JPL-SE.used: Intel 8085 computer, five laser stripers, odometry and inertial sensing (via V1 register)

PDS-HOST.title: PDS - Mars Pathfinder Rover Description (insthost)
PDS-HOST.used: 13 cm wheel, 2000:1 wheel gearing, independent corner steering / turn in place, 0.4 m/min; 3 x 1 W RHUs; 80C85 100 kips; 0.22 m2 array of 13 strings x 18 GaAs cells; 9 LiSOCl2 D cells 150 W-h; 16 W peak; half-duplex UHF modem

PDS-CAM.title: PDS - Rover Camera Instrument Description (rcinst)
PDS-CAM.used: 12.56 cm stereo baseline, ~26 cm height, -22.5 deg front / -41.4 deg aft boresight, FOV, 768 x 484 CCD, sapphire window, ZnSe lens; aft colour camera rotated 90 deg near the APXS

NSSDC.title: NASA NSSDCA - Mars Pathfinder Rover (MESURPR)
NSSDC.used: 280 x 630 x 480 mm, 130 mm ground clearance, 180 mm stowed height, 10.5 kg, 0.2 m2 of cells, LiSOCl2 D-cell backup

NTRS-ADM.title: NTRS 19950020845 - APXS Deployment Mechanism for the Mars Rover (Blomquist, 1995)
NTRS-ADM.used: one actuated DOF, Maxon brush DC + 2000:1 Globe gearbox, parallel-link arm (front/back/horizontal/transverse links), 90 deg phase, 3-rod flexible wrist +-25 deg (A=0.066, B=0.125, L=0.053 m), 40 mm spacer, 76 mm bumper on 3 plungers with LED sensors, Cerrobend 60 C fail-safe, Negator springs, envelope 0.24 x 0.21 x 0.14 m, < 0.5 kg, reach 0.29 m rocks / 0.05 m below wheels

NTRS-WAE.title: NTRS 19980000043 - Wheel Abrasion Experiment (NASA TM 113123)
NTRS-WAE.used: centre-right wheel, black-anodised Al strip on the tread, 5 patches each of Al/Ni/Pt 200-1000 A, pattern ref/200/ref/300/450/ref/700/1000, 1 cm 7075 photodetector on the bogie, 30 deg incidence, 19.2 mm

WIKI-SOJ.title: Wikipedia - Sojourner (rover) (secondary; cites Bickler 1997, Matijevic 1997/98, NASA fact sheets)
WIKI-SOJ.used: wheel width 7.9 cm, serrated stainless cleats, 8 cm obstacles, steering potentiometers, 9600 baud UHF modem, aerogel 20 mg/cc, memory map

WIKI-RB.title: Wikipedia - Rocker-bogie (secondary)
WIKI-RB.used: on Sojourner the front wheels attach to the bogies (MER/MSL: to the rockers)

WIKI-MAE.title: Wikipedia - Materials Adherence Experiment (secondary)
WIKI-MAE.used: front-left corner of the solar array; GaAs cell under a removable Suprasil cover glass moved by a shape-memory actuator

NASA-GRC.title: NASA Glenn - Mars Pathfinder experiments (MAE, WAE)
NASA-GRC.used: WAE: centre section of one wheel coated with Ni, Al, Pt; MAE measures dust on the array

ICES.title: JPL - Sojourner overview paper (ICES)
ICES.used: earlier-configuration dimensions (68 x 48 x 28 cm, 17 cm clearance) - superseded by JPL-ROB/NSSDC

PIA00621.title: NASA PIA00621 - Colour mosaic of rover & terrain (sol 1 caption)
PIA00621.used: rover latched to the petal before deployment; ramps

V1.title: NEPTUNI Sojourner V1 package (FUENTES_y_limites.md) - JPL flight photograph pathfinder1-590, PIA00906, PIA01122, PIA00646, PIA01560, PIA15277, JPL-26575AC/BC board photos, NASA TM 107378/107449
V1.used: photographic outlines reused as visual references: perforated suspension plates, dish wheels, WEB stepped deck, array perimeter, antenna proportions and position, camera/laser layout, side harness routes, board silhouettes
